<Render file="page-rules-migration" product="cache" />

`example.com`을 포함하는 모든 호스트명에 대해 `test_cookie` 쿠키가 포함된 요청은 캐시를 우회하도록 [캐시 규칙 만들기](/cache/how-to/cache-rules/create-dashboard/):

<Example>

- **When incoming requests match**: Custom filter expression
  - Using the Expression Builder:<br/>
    `Hostname contains "example.com" AND Cookie contains "test-cookie"`
  - Using the Expression Editor:<br/>
    `(http.host contains "example.com" and http.cookie contains "test-cookie")`

- **Then**:
  - **Cache eligibility**: Bypass cache

</Example>
